fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck-only entrance off Depot Court SE; internal yard controlled by a checkpoint with gate islands and lane markings.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small dark-roofed booth (~1-vehicle footprint) sits in the middle of the central truck drive between the RDC building and the trailer drop yard, with gate islands and a queuing truck visible at z20.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock RDC: dock doors run along both long faces of the building (inbound one side, outbound the other).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved gate apron and large open yard around the checkpoint leave ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Hundreds of marked trailer stalls fill the yard SW of the building and along the NE side.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Lane count at the checkpoint estimated from overhead gate-island markings; not crisply resolved.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: HD RDC is the single ~467k sq ft building; the larger building to the SW is a separate tenant in the Mill Creek Corporate Center industrial park, excluded from the HD perimeter.
